name: Discover DFG (Relational)
description: Directly-Follows Graph discovery expressed as a Promenade Relational Program — the reference action that proves the relational API and its SQL Profile v1 against a real algorithm. Targets the same DFG artifact type as the Rust/WASM discoverer (core.discover.dfg), so the two are directly comparable.

minFrequency.title: Minimum edge frequency
minFrequency.description: Directly-follows pairs seen fewer than this many times are dropped before the result leaves the query — the same parameter core.discover.dfg exposes, so the two discoverers can be compared edge-for-edge.
